title: Import Audit Totals Match
description: A CSV import's response tells the admin what just happened — the audit trail should tell the exact same story later, with no drift between what the admin saw on screen and what's permanently on file.
successCondition: POST /api/admin/shipments/import with a CSV of 4 rows: 2 valid, 2 invalid (different reasons — e.g. one unknown customerEmail, one non-numeric weightKg). Note the response's totalRows/accepted/rejected (4/2/2). Querying audit_log via `npm run db:psql` for the newest action = 'shipment.csv_import' row confirms its metadata JSON has totalRows: 4, accepted: 2, rejected: 2 — exactly matching the API response, not an approximation or a count of only the successful rows.
hints: importShipmentsCsv (apps/api/src/modules/admin/service.ts) computes rows/accepted/rejected once and reuses those exact numbers both in the HTTP response and in the recordAudit metadata call — they should never be able to drift apart.
CSV formatting rules (required columns, quoting fields with commas) are documented in docs/api/admin.md.
